import zipfile, hashlib
w='/usr/local/lib/python3.13/ensurepip/_bundled/pip-24.3.1-py3-none-any.whl'
z=zipfile.ZipFile(w)
names=z.namelist()
print("entries:", len(names))
print("has pip/__init__.py:", 'pip/__init__.py' in names)
print("has pip/_internal/cli/main.py:", 'pip/_internal/cli/main.py' in names)
# verify wheel integrity via its own RECORD hashes
bad=0
rec=z.read('pip-24.3.1.dist-info/RECORD').decode().splitlines()
import base64
for line in rec:
    p,hashpart,_ = line.partition(',')
    if not hashpart: continue
    algo,b64 = hashpart.split('=',1)
    pad='='*(-len(b64)%4)
    want=base64.urlsafe_b64decode(b64+pad)
    try:
        data=z.read(p)
    except KeyError:
        print("MISSING in wheel:", p); bad+=1; continue
    got=hashlib.sha256(data).digest()
    if got!=want:
        print("HASH MISMATCH:", p); bad+=1
print("checksum failures:", bad)
EOF

summary:
bash: python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile, hashlib, base64
w='/usr/local/lib/python3.13/ensurepip/_bundled/pip-24.3.1-py3-none-any.whl'
z=zipfile.ZipFile(w)
rec=z.read('pip-24.3.1.dist-info/RECORD').decode().splitlines()
bad=[]; oops=[]; checked=0
for i,line in enumerate(rec):
    parts=line.split(',')
    if len(parts)!=3:
        oops.append((i,line)); continue
    p,hashpart,size=parts
    if not hashpart: continue
    try:
        algo,b64=hashpart.split('=',1)
    except ValueError:
        oops.append((i,line)); continue
    data=z.read(p) if p in z.namelist() else None
    if data is None:
        bad.append(('missing',p)); continue
    got=hashlib.new(algo.replace('-','_'),data).digest()
    want=base64.urlsafe_b64decode(b64+'='*(-len(b64)%4))
    checked+=1
    if got!=want: bad.append(('hash',p))
print("RECORD lines:", len(rec), "checked:", checked)
print("malformed lines:", oops)
print("failures:", bad)
print("testzip (crc):", z.testzip())
EOF
